Equip in a ring/hands slot. Hold %s for 1s: summon one, up to four
Sneak and hold %s for 1s: recall all, with no cooldown
No time limit; one Drowned Woman per nail
Unequipping, owner death, logout or dimension travel recalls them
Guardian death: that nail cools down for 10 minutes; others stay usable
Also Darkness 3s, Nausea 5s and Slowness II 5s
Strong melee, sustained regeneration and grabs; server-tuned stats
tooltip.sound_isolating_eraser.summon_gu: Actively attacks hostile mobs within %s blocks of the owner
Defends the owner first, then assists the owner's attacks
Spares owner, their pets, villagers, iron golems and creative players

tooltip.sound_isolating_eraser.red_nails: %s: her Drowned Woman is with you
Unbound: the first one to chant becomes its owner
message.sound_isolating_eraser.red_nails: Precious Memory: Drowned Woman guardians. Equip the nails and hold the summon key for 1s; up to four guardians.
Strong melee and sustained regeneration. They hunt nearby hostile mobs, prioritizing your defence and your attacks.
No time limit. Sneak and hold the summon key to recall all with no cooldown. Unequipping, owner death, logout or dimension travel also recalls them.
Guardian death: that nail cools down for 10 minutes. Backlash deals 4 armor-bypassing damage, Darkness for 3s, and Nausea and Slowness II for 5s.
They spare you, your pets, villagers, iron golems and creative players. Existing PvP and team rules remain unchanged.
Default guard radius: 16 blocks around the owner. Range and combat stats are server-configurable.
Put the red nails on first.
The nails are ice-cold. They prick you and you pull your hand back.
A Drowned Woman crawls out of the water. (%s/4)
All four Drowned Women are already by your side.
The nails have not grown back yet. The next one is ready in %s.
You take off the red nails, and the Drowned Women sink back into the water.
The red nail on your left %s tears off. The pain turns your vision black.
The red nail on your left %s has grown back.

%1$s's red nail tore off along with the flesh while fighting %2$s
tooltip.sound_isolating_eraser.shaxiadao: Special attack effects against hostile aberrant creatures
tooltip.sound_isolating_eraser.pill_warn: Withdrawal follows the boost. Milk cannot cure it by default.
item.sound_isolating_eraser.sound_isolat: Drawing rejected: check space, surface, protection and durability
item.sound_isolating_eraser.wind_thunder: Silver-white wings laced with gold, forged from a thunder-roc feather
Double-tap SPACE mid-air to deploy; C tier, H hover, R blink
item.sound_isolating_eraser.thunder_feat: A lightning-conducting feather left when a phantom is struck down by a bolt
message.sound_isolating_eraser.hungry: Too hungry — the wings cannot hold this tier
message.sound_isolating_eraser.charged: Thunder-charged! Flight and blink cost no hunger for 60s
death.attack.sound_isolating_eraser.corr: %1$s was dissolved by corrosion while fighting %2$s
message.sound_isolating_eraser.city.arri: You woke up, but dawn never came.
message.sound_isolating_eraser.city.entr: The city could not be reached. You remain safely in this world.
message.sound_isolating_eraser.city.unsa: No safe return point near your bed or world spawn. Your door progress is preserved.
message.sound_isolating_eraser.city.mile: The darkness beyond the doors begins to stir.
A low echo reaches you from afar.
message.sound_isolating_eraser.fertilize: This crop is already fully grown.
No room to grow: the tree needs open space, plain soil below and no creatures in the way.
Use on a crop, sapling, grass block or fertile log.
tooltip.sound_isolating_eraser.suxia_poc: A faded wedding photo is set inside the lid. The case is engraved:
"Li Chengyuan & Wu Suxia, together for a hundred years"
Right-click the watch: summon one Suxia guardian for 60 seconds
Right-click again while she is out to close the watch and recall her
Expiry or recall: 3-minute cooldown. Guardian death: 10 minutes
Death backlash: owner suffers Nausea for 5s and Weakness for 10s
Heavy melee guardian; combat stats are server-configurable
Unbound: the first person to open it becomes its owner
message.sound_isolating_eraser.suxia_poc: Precious Memory: Suxia guardian. Right-click the watch to summon her for 60s; right-click again to recall her early.
Heavy melee. She hunts hostile mobs near you, prioritizing your defence and your attacks. Default radius: 16 blocks, server-configurable.
Expiry or recall starts a 3-minute cooldown. Owner death, logout or dimension travel also ends the summon.
Suxia's death: 10-minute cooldown, plus Nausea for 5s and Weakness for 10s on the owner.
She spares you, your pets, villagers, iron golems and creative players. Existing PvP and team rules remain unchanged.
The watch is cold. It does not know you.
The hands are frozen. Wait %s more.
There is no room here for Suxia to come out.
Suxia has fallen. Something rings inside your skull.
guide.sound_isolating_eraser.hold_both: Hold Shift for use and cost; Ctrl for the story
guide.sound_isolating_eraser.hold_shift: Hold Shift for use and cost
guide.sound_isolating_eraser.sound_isola: Spend durability to place sound-isolating walls.

Place the selected wall shape on a block, %s blocks high per column. Dot, horizontal, vertical, diagonal and ring use 1, 5, 5, 5 and 12 columns. Aggro isolation depends on mob tags and wall occlusion.
Press %s to place; %s changes shape. Cannot be used on the underside of a block.
No dedicated ability cooldown. Space, support, permissions, loaded chunks and entity obstruction are checked.
%s durability remains. Each successful column costs one point in survival, not each block; creative spends none. A failed check rejects the entire placement without durability loss.
It erases not the sound, but the road by which the sound reaches the other side.
guide.sound_isolating_eraser.gravity_jad: A jade pendant that suppresses foes with a gravity field.
Equip in the necklace slot to cast a stationary field that aids allies and slams enemies on a normal ending. Default radius: 16 blocks, configurable; the area must be loaded.
Press %s while equipped. Wearing Red Nails blocks activation even after rebinding the key.
Current duration: %s seconds; cooldown from successful casting: %s seconds.
No pendant durability is spent, but tagged fragile blocks can break. Surface-break chance defaults to one in four and is configurable. Watch nearby structures.
No landscape is carved into the jade, yet its bearer hears the world sink.
guide.sound_isolating_eraser.brickrot_sp: Use on a block face to generate Brickrot Wall. Use on a compatible spawner to change its entity type.
Hold the egg and press %s on the target.
No dedicated ability cooldown; vanilla spawn-egg placement and spawning rules apply.
Successful use spends one egg in survival, but not in creative. The creature is not guaranteed to be friendly; leave safe space.
Its thin shell resembles old plaster, too light to hide the chill between bricks.
guide.sound_isolating_eraser.empty_ferti: Keep it as a collectible; it has no direct refill or fertilizing action.
No active ability or dedicated cooldown.
It cannot restore fertilizer uses and has no growth effect.
By the time the mouth is folded shut, the last grain of spring has reached the soil.
guide.sound_isolating_eraser.empty_pill_: The empty wrapper of an Enhancement Pill Pack.
Keep it as a collectible. It contains no pills, cannot be consumed again and has no direct refill action.
No active effect or dedicated cooldown.
It grants no enhancement or healing; the empty wrapper itself does not cause withdrawal.
Each dent in the foil remembers a moment of borrowed strength.
guide.sound_isolating_eraser.enhancement: Temporary bodily enhancement followed by withdrawal.
Grants Strength, Speed, Haste and Resistance: default levels II, II, II and I, configurable by the server. The current effect lasts %s seconds; another dose refreshes rather than adds duration.
Hold %s with the pack in hand until consumption finishes.
Current consumption time: %s seconds, with no extra ability cooldown.

Spends one dose, leaving an empty pack when exhausted; creative consumption is configurable. Withdrawal lasts %s seconds: default Slowness II, Fatigue II, Weakness II and Darkness. Milk cure is disabled by default but can be enabled. Penalties are configurable. No repairs or enchanting.
The wrapper never promised strength, only to postpone the weariness.
guide.sound_isolating_eraser.fertile_fru: A healing fruit that cleanses harmful effects.
Eating restores %s hunger and %s health, removes harmful effects and grants Regeneration II for %s seconds. Edible while full; values follow server settings.
Hold %s with the fruit in hand to eat.
Uses normal food eating time, with no extra ability cooldown.
One fruit is consumed per meal in survival. Repeated meals do not stack unlimited copies of regeneration.
Its flesh holds no seed, only the sweetness of a forest after rain.
guide.sound_isolating_eraser.fertile_lea: Fruit-bearing leaves that support the healing aura.
At least %s fertile logs, leaves or planks in the surrounding 5×5×5 area grant Regeneration I. Shears or Silk Touch collect leaves; normal breaking or decay may drop fruit and saplings.
Press %s to place; choose the appropriate harvesting tool.
The aura is passive with no active cooldown. Fruit drops do not replenish on a timer.
Placement spends a block in survival. Natural drops are random; unsupported natural leaves decay.
The thin leaves hold heavy drops, as though keeping an entire rainfall.
guide.sound_isolating_eraser.fertile_log: Fertile timber for crafting and the nearby regeneration aura.
Craft one log into four planks. At least %s fertile logs, leaves or planks in the 5×5×5 area around you grant Regeneration I; leaving ends the aura.
Press %s to place. Fertilizer can further cultivate a trunk that still belongs to a tracked fertile tree.
The aura is passive, with no active cooldown; the server periodically checks nearby blocks.
Placement spends a block in survival. Removing a tree's root clears its growth record; placed logs do not automatically become expandable trees.
Quiet green rings linger in the wood, even after it leaves its roots.
guide.sound_isolating_eraser.fertile_pla: Building planks that retain the fertile wood's regeneration aura.
One fertile log makes four planks. At least %s fertile logs, leaves or planks in the surrounding 5×5×5 area grant Regeneration I, using the server's threshold.
Press %s to place. Its vanilla planks tag also works in compatible recipes.
The aura is passive, with no active ability cooldown.
Placement and crafting spend materials in survival. Healing requires enough nearby blocks and does not work remotely.
The saw parted the trunk, but not the life running through its grain.
guide.sound_isolating_eraser.fertile_sap: A sapling for growing a fertile tree.
Plant on suitable soil with room to grow. Use natural growth, bone meal or Super Fertilizer; a tracked grown trunk can receive more fertilizer. Saplings do not count toward the aura.
Press %s to plant, then use growth materials on the sapling.
Natural growth follows random ticks and environmental conditions, not a fixed countdown.
Planting spends one sapling in survival. Natural growth needs suitable conditions; fertilizer growth needs room and respects protection and world boundaries.
It casts no shade yet, but already seems to be waiting for a future traveler.
guide.sound_isolating_eraser.neon_tumor_: Use on a block face to generate Neon Tumor. Use on a compatible spawner to change its entity type.
Hold the egg and press %s on the target.
No dedicated ability cooldown; vanilla spawn-egg placement and spawning rules apply.
Successful use spends one egg in survival, but not in creative. The creature is not guaranteed to be friendly; leave safe space.
Faint color clings to the shell like neon reluctant to fade after closing time.
guide.sound_isolating_eraser.red_nails.u: Equip one set in a ring or hands slot. Chant 1s per ghost (max 4); sneak-chant or unequip to recall all.
guide.sound_isolating_eraser.red_nails.c: Hold %s to chant; add %s to recall.
Recall adds no cooldown; a ghost's death locks its finger for 600s.
First summon binds permanently; nails stay removable. Ghost death: its living owner takes 4 backlash damage, Darkness (3s), Nausea (5s) and Slowness II (5s).
guide.sound_isolating_eraser.red_nails.l: The unfading red is no decoration, but a promise still waiting for an answer.
guide.sound_isolating_eraser.shadow_tang: Use on a block face to generate Shadow Tangler. Use on a compatible spawner to change its entity type.
Hold the egg and press %s on the target.
No dedicated ability cooldown; vanilla spawn-egg placement and spawning rules apply.
Successful use spends one egg in survival, but not in creative. The creature is not guaranteed to be friendly; leave safe space.
Move it into the light and its shadow seems reluctant to follow.
guide.sound_isolating_eraser.shaxiadao.s: A melee blade against hostile aberrant creatures.
guide.sound_isolating_eraser.shaxiadao.u: Main-hand strikes add normal and armor-bypassing damage against eligible mobs, scaling with attack charge by default. Players do not receive this bonus. Resistance, Protection, absorption and totems still apply.
guide.sound_isolating_eraser.shaxiadao.c: Hold the blade in your main hand and press %s to attack.
No separate ability cooldown; attack recovery and the target's hurt invulnerability still apply.
Uses normal sword durability, with a maximum of 1561. No sweeping or damage/sweeping enchantments. Materials cannot repair it; two matching blades can be combined in a grindstone.
guide.sound_isolating_eraser.shaxiadao.l: Its name sounds like a hastily written verdict; its edge never answers for the hand.
guide.sound_isolating_eraser.super_ferti: A limited-use fertilizer for crops, trees and meadows.

Use on crops, saplings, fertile trunks or grass. The same player's %s doses must target one tracked tree or one grass location to expand growth; counts do not combine across targets and crops do not count. Groves target %s trees and need room.
Press %s on the target block to fertilize it.
Cooldown: 0.2 seconds after success. Mature crops and obstructed growth do not benefit.
Each success spends one use; %s / %s remain. An exhausted bag becomes an empty bag and cannot be repaired. Failed growth costs no uses; expansion changes nearby vegetation.
The soil at the bottom still smells of spring, but more than one season pours out.
guide.sound_isolating_eraser.suxia_pocke: A permanently bound watch that summons Suxia to aid you.
Use to summon for 60 seconds; use again to recall. Each owner may have only one active summon, with valid nearby space required.
Hold the watch and press %s to summon or recall.
Cooldown begins when the summon ends: 180 seconds after recall or normal expiry, 600 seconds after death.
First use binds before space checks, even if summoning then fails. No durability cost; Suxia's death also gives the owner Nausea for 5s and Weakness I for 10s.
The hands keep their own rhythm, holding time for someone who is late.
guide.sound_isolating_eraser.suxia_spawn: Use on a block face to generate Suxia. Use on a compatible spawner to change its entity type.
Hold the egg and press %s on the target.
No dedicated ability cooldown; vanilla spawn-egg placement and spawning rules apply.
Successful use spends one egg in survival, but not in creative. The creature is not guaranteed to be friendly; leave safe space.
Within the quiet shell, someone seems to have saved a farewell for last.
guide.sound_isolating_eraser.thunder_fea: A lightning-struck phantom feather for Wind-Thunder Wings.
A phantom killed by lightning damage drops one; merely being struck is not enough. The Wind-Thunder Wings recipe requires three feathers.
Use in a crafting recipe; there is no active ability key.
No active ability or dedicated cooldown.
Crafting consumes the material. Its dropped item resists lightning and specified fire damage, not every damage type.
A bright line in the shaft resembles a stroke the sky could not take back.
guide.sound_isolating_eraser.water_ghost: Use on a block face to generate Drowned Woman. Use on a compatible spawner to change its entity type.
Hold the egg and press %s on the target.
No dedicated ability cooldown; vanilla spawn-egg placement and spawning rules apply.
Successful use spends one egg in survival, but not in creative. The creature is not guaranteed to be friendly; leave safe space.
The shell has dried, but the water within has not fallen silent.
guide.sound_isolating_eraser.wind_thunde: Chest-slot wings for flight, hovering and blinking.

Equip as chest armor. Defaults: food at least 4 to deploy, 6 for fast tiers; blink range 24 blocks. Wearing prevents fall damage. Lightning refills food and grants 60s of flight/blink exhaustion immunity. Values are configurable.
In midair, double-tap %s within 0.3s to deploy or fold. %s changes tier, %s hovers and %s blinks.
Default blink cooldown: 2s. Up to three chained blinks within 0.6s of the first; completing the chain locks blinking for 8s. Configurable.
Default exhaustion per second by tier: 0.4/0.8/2/4; blinking adds 6, not that many hunger points. An unsafe destination cancels blink costs. Fast wall impacts can hurt, up to 10 damage by default.
Wind holds the feathers and thunder stays in the quills; distance does not erase the body's weight.
